subject: Mathematics
topicAf: Annuïteite betaalbaar aan die begin en uitgestelde lenings

items.q: R200 is paid at the beginning of each month for 3 months at 1% per month. What is the future value (closest)?
items.qAf: R200 word aan die begin van elke maand vir 3 maande betaal teen 1% per maand. Wat is die toekomstige waarde (die naaste)?
items.explain: The ordinary future value is 200(1,01³ − 1) ÷ 0,01 ≈ R606. Multiplying by 1,01 for beginning-of-period payments gives R612.
items.explainAf: Die gewone toekomstige waarde is 200(1,01³ − 1) ÷ 0,01 ≈ R606. Vermenigvuldig met 1,01 vir betalings aan die begin gee R612.

items.q: Other things being equal, which timing gives the larger future value at the end of the term?
items.qAf: Watter tydsberekening gee, al die ander dinge gelyk, die groter toekomstige waarde aan die einde van die termyn?
options: Payments at the beginning of each period
Payments at the end of each period
It depends on whether the rate is zero
optionsAf: Payments at the beginning of each period
Payments at the end of each period
It depends on whether the rate is zero
items.explain: Payments made earlier earn one more period of interest.
items.explainAf: Betalings wat vroeër gemaak word, verdien een ekstra tydperk rente.

items.q: Five yearly payments of R10 000 are made at the beginning of each year at 8% per annum. What is the future value (closest)?
items.qAf: Vyf jaarlikse betalings van R10 000 word aan die begin van elke jaar gemaak teen 8% per jaar. Wat is die toekomstige waarde (die naaste)?
items.explain: Ordinary FV = 10 000 × 5,8666 ≈ R58 666. Multiply by 1,08: R63 360.
items.explainAf: Gewone TW = 10 000 × 5,8666 ≈ R58 666. Vermenigvuldig met 1,08: R63 360.

items.q: A loan of R100 000 at 1% per month has no payments for 2 months. What is the balance owed at the end of month 2?
items.qAf: ’n Lening van R100 000 teen 1% per maand het geen betalings vir 2 maande nie. Wat is die saldo aan die einde van maand 2?

items.q: The balance of R102 010 at the end of month 2 is repaid by 12 equal monthly payments starting at the end of month 3, at 1% per month. What is the monthly instalment (closest)?
items.qAf: Die saldo van R102 010 aan die einde van maand 2 word terugbetaal deur 12 gelyke maandelikse betalings wat aan die einde van maand 3 begin, teen 1% per maand. Wat is die maandelikse paaiement (die naaste)?

items.q: Why must the balance at the end of a deferment be found before the instalments are calculated?
items.qAf: Waarom moet die saldo aan die einde van ’n uitstel bepaal word voordat die paaiemente bereken word?
options: The instalments are based on the balance owed when repayments start
Payments are made at the start of the loan
The loan is cleared during deferment
optionsAf: The instalments are based on the balance owed when repayments start
Payments are made at the start of the loan
The loan is cleared during deferment
items.explain: The repayment annuity is calculated from the balance at the start of repayment, which includes the interest added during deferment.
items.explainAf: Die terugbetalingsannuïteit word uit die saldo aan die begin van terugbetaling bereken, wat die rente insluit wat tydens uitstel bygevoeg is.

items.q: An annuity whose payments are made at the beginning of each period.
items.qAf: ’n Annuïteit waarvan die betalings aan die begin van elke tydperk gemaak word.

items.q: A loan whose first payment is made some time after the loan is granted.
items.qAf: ’n Lening waarvan die eerste betaling ’n ruk nadat die lening toegestaan is, gemaak word.

items.text: During the delay of a deferred loan, interest is added so the balance [[]]. The present-value formula is then applied to the [[]] balance.
items.textAf: Gedurende die uitstel van ’n uitgestelde lening word rente bygevoeg, dus [[]] die balans. Die huidige-waarde-formule word dan op die [[]] balans toegepas.

items.q: A savings annuity due gives a larger future value than an ordinary annuity with the same payments.
items.qAf: ’n Vooruitbetaalde spaarannuïteit gee ’n groter toekomstige waarde as ’n gewone annuïteit met dieselfde betalings.
items.explain: True. Each payment earns interest for one extra period.
items.explainAf: Waar. Elke betaling verdien rente vir een ekstra tydperk.

items.q: A loan of R50 000 at 12% p.a. compounded monthly has its first payment deferred by 3 months. What is the balance after 3 months, in rand? Round to the nearest rand.
items.qAf: ’n Lening van R50 000 teen 12% p.j. maandeliks saamgestel het sy eerste betaling 3 maande uitgestel. Wat is die balans ná 3 maande, in rand? Rond af tot die naaste rand.
